description: This file defines a custom form type 'EmailType' extending Symfony's core EmailType, customizing its options and view variables for use within a Symfony PHP application.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\EmailType
classes.description: A custom form type that extends Symfony's EmailType to add additional options and customize the rendering view.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the email form, including 'pre_addon', 'post_addon', and 'row_class'.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the parent form type, Symfony's EmailType.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for the form block, here 'custom_email'.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables to include custom options for rendering.
